concerns.text: FR-007 mandates a disclaimer string in 'every result JSON'. Task T030 is marked `[ ]` (unstarted) and is the only task addressing this. Without T030 completion, the final deliverable violates FR-007.

FR-002 requires skipping configurations where stratified subsampling to N=15 is impossible. T005 introduces logic to 'reduce N (e.g., N=15 -> N=10)', which contradicts the fixed sample size thresholds (N=15, 25, 40) defined in the spec and plan, altering the experimental design without a corresponding task to update the spec or plan.

US-1 requires a baseline on 'original, non-augmented' data. T014 implements ground truth logic (label permutation/mean shift) inside `code/simulation.py` for the Baseline story. The spec separates baseline (US-1) from ground truth manipulation (US-2/Plan). T014 conflates these, risking contamination of the baseline error rates required by US-1.

FR-001 requires downloading datasets. T004 implements fetching with a 'log warning' on deviation. T038 re-implements URL validation with a 'FAIL LOUDLY' constraint. The tasks do not clarify which logic governs execution when a dataset is missing, creating a conflict in satisfying FR-001's error handling.

The Edge Cases section in spec.md requires handling zero-variance samples. T040 is marked `[ ]` (unstarted) and notes the log file format is invalid. Without T040 completion, the edge case handling for SMOTE (FR-003/US-2) is incomplete and the logging mechanism is broken.

SC-002 requires measuring statistical power against baseline. T038b is marked `[ ]` (unstarted) and is the only task explicitly addressing 'Power Analysis Verification'. Without this, the plan's claim to measure power (SC-002) lacks a corresponding implementation task.

SC-004 requires measuring runtime against a time limit. T042 is marked `[ ]` (unstarted) and is the only task adding 'Computational Cost' metrics to the report. Without T042, the success criterion SC-004 (measured against time limit) is not explicitly addressed in the final report generation.

Plan.md lists `quickstart.md` as a Phase 1 output. T036 is marked `[ ]` (unstarted) and scheduled in Phase N. This creates a gap where the plan's required artifact is not covered by a completed task in the correct phase, potentially blocking downstream validation.
